scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace @crowd-control/compiler && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspaces && cargo build --workspace
scripts.bench:engine: npm run build --workspace @crowd-control/contract && npm run build:wasm && cargo build --release -p crowd-control-engine --example movement_bench && node engine/scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.test:wasm: npm run build --workspace @crowd-control/compiler && npm run build:wasm && cargo build -p crowd-control-engine --example protocol && node --test engine/test/wasm.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @crowd-control/compiler && npm run typecheck --workspaces && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo check --workspace
scripts.test: npm run test:dev && npm run test --workspace @crowd-control/contract && npm run test --workspace @crowd-control/history && npm run test --workspace @crowd-control/server && npm run test --workspace @crowd-control/compiler && npm run test --workspace @crowd-control/web && cargo test --workspace && node --test engine/test/native.test.mjs
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:wasm && npm run dev --workspace @crowd-control/web
